A finding matches when rule ids are equal, paths are equal, and the reported line is in [line, end_line]. 'required': a correct v0.1 linter must report it. 'optional': a real bug the linter may report but isn't required to (it needs information v0.1 doesn't resolve). Any other finding is a false positive.
